metadata.description: Claude Code mods for long, parallel, mostly unattended work: worktree pinning, enforced rules, PR watching without polling, enforced modes, claim checks, auto-continue, memory at the tool call, save points before compaction, a view of every live session, proven fixes, second-model review, loud shell failures, container headroom and MCP argument repair.

plugins.name: anchor
plugins.description: Pin a session to its git worktree: every Bash call runs from the anchor, and the primary checkout is guarded against stray edits and git writes.

plugins.name: tripwire
plugins.description: Rules that are enforced, not remembered: deny, ask, rewrite or note on any tool call, subagents included. A pixel-art trap for every mistake you already wrote down.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Watch PRs outside the model: polls CI, reviews and threads with gh, wakes the session only when something actionable happens, and denies sleep-poll loops while it watches.

plugins.name: stance
plugins.description: Session modes that are enforced, not requested: investigate, draft, build, ship. Denies the tool calls a stance rules out, auto-switches on phrases like "no code", and shows a pixel-art class badge above the prompt.

plugins.name: anti-cheat
plugins.description: No claims without evidence: flags "tests pass", "CI green" and "verified" claims that nothing in the turn backs up.

plugins.name: respawn
plugins.description: Auto-continue after a turn dies on a network or API error: a pixel-art CONTINUE? countdown with backoff and 3 lives per hour.

plugins.name: radar
plugins.description: Memory at the moment it matters: when a tool call touches what one of your memory files is about, radar attaches that memory's description and rules for the model to read. A lavender pixel-art radar pings each match.

plugins.name: quicksave
plugins.description: A save point before compaction: the task's goal, step, branch, links, decisions, rules and next step are saved before /compact and handed back to the model after it, with a pixel-art SAVE POINT band when it is safe to compact.

plugins.name: party
plugins.description: A raid frame for every live session on the machine: who is working, who is waiting on you and for how long, per-PR locks so two sessions never act on one PR, and /broadcast to the rest of the party.

plugins.name: prove-it
plugins.description: The fix must make a test fail first: reverts your source changes, runs the changed tests and requires a failure, restores (verified by hash) and requires a pass. Optional gate on git push and gh pr create.

plugins.name: co-op
plugins.description: A second player reviews before the PR: gh pr create waits for a second-model review of the branch diff, and a failing review with a high finding blocks it.

plugins.name: honest-exit
plugins.description: Make silent shell failures loud: a glob that matched nothing, a command missing from the agent's shell, or a pipe that hid a failing exit status gets a note the model reads and a peach pixel-art toast.

plugins.name: dock
plugins.description: Container stacks per worktree: a pixel-art pane of every compose stack with its memory and worktree, orphans whose worktree is gone, and a guard that asks before booting another stack when memory headroom is low.

plugins.name: tracer
plugins.description: Merged is not deployed: follow a merged PR or commit through its workflow runs, deployments and an optional live URL with gh, on a pixel-art level map, and wake the session once when it is live or a stage fails.

plugins.name: mender
plugins.description: Fix the arguments, not the model: repairs malformed MCP tool arguments ("true" for true, numbers as strings, unknown keys) against the tool's schema before the call, tells the model what it fixed, and flags servers that are down. A pixel-art patch log.
